transport: Local operator host: loopback peer and Host/Origin validation, same-origin browser session; service owns record authorization. Not a cloud auth contract.

adapter_registration.composition: default_registry() returns a fresh registry containing the two demo adapters; TaskRegistry() is empty. CLI composition explicitly injects its registry. OptimizationService defaults preserve existing callers.
adapter_registration.registration: registry.register(adapter_instance) -> None; adapter is trusted caller-installed code, not a document-selected class or import. Duplicate ids refuse with duplicate_task; missing ids refuse with unknown_task.

describe() -> dict.name: nonempty string
describe() -> dict.configuration_schema: closed bounded object schema using supported subset below
describe() -> dict.submissions: one or two schema-valid config objects; offline ordered candidate fixtures, not supplied to native authoring
describe() -> dict.desired_behavior: nonempty native authoring objective; supplied together with baseline config and schema

methods.validate_candidate(config: dict) -> None: Additional trusted validation; raise ValueError or Refusal on invalid configuration. Registry enforces schema first and passes a copy.
methods.evaluate(snapshot: dict, baseline: bool): Return exactly the registered baseline_checks or candidate_checks. Each item has only name, status (passed|failed|blocked), detail (string). Empty, missing, extra or malformed checks refuse. Registry adds a non-baseline configuration-changed check. All checks must pass; document references cannot weaken them.

configuration_schema_subset.rules: Objects require additionalProperties=false and every property required. Arrays require maxItems in 0..256. Nesting exceeds 8 refuses. Unknown keywords, references, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite values, extra config fields and boolean-as-number refuse. This is a restricted subset, not general JSON Schema support. Config JSON is bounded to 8192 UTF-8 bytes.

adapter_registration.integrity: Task metadata, baseline bytes, schema and candidate fixtures are frozen by digest. Evaluator pins include declaring module bytes, stable runtime code/constants and inherited helpers, plus registry source. Checked before and after evaluation and restoration. Adapters must declare behavior-affecting state in describe/baseline and remain stable during a run. External dependencies, global state and malicious host code are not isolated or transitively pinned.
adapter_registration.compatibility: service.TASKS, service._config and service._evaluate remain compatibility views/delegates for demos. Service tasks() and existing GET /api/tasks use the injected registry. No HTTP route changes.

experiment_document.format: Strict JSON object, at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes; YAML, imports, commands, shell snippets and authority fields are unsupported. Unknown fields refuse at every document level.

fields.task_version: must equal registered positive integer task version

limits.timeout_seconds: finite number greater than 0 and at most 120

fields.quality_constraints: nonempty unique references to registered candidate_checks; all adapter checks remain mandatory

pins.evaluator_digest: optional expected lowercase sha256; both keys required when pins is supplied

experiment_document.preflight: Validates schema, registered task/version, references, caller permission/caps, expected pins and passing baseline. Returns ready receipt with baseline checks/digest, task/evaluator pins, experiment digest and metric version. No executor dispatch; CLI preflight creates no storage root. Failed document admission creates no run.
experiment_document.run: Revalidates preflight, freezes document and receipt, checks baseline again, runs bounded config-only submissions, and persists existing run/event/candidate records. Idempotency includes experiment digest. Failures retain evidence; no improvement claim is inferred from acceptance.
experiment_document.limits_semantics: Document timeout covers admitted run work at safe boundaries and limits each native call to remaining budget. Trusted synchronous adapter calls cannot be forcibly interrupted. Native document limits cannot exceed caller service caps. Deterministic max_submissions cannot exceed available fixtures. Comparison policy remains acceptance-only/inconclusive.
experiment_document.authority: allow_model_calls and executor credentials/configuration belong only to trusted host/CLI. Document cannot grant permission, select executable code, add tools, install adapters or change source. Native preflight does not probe model credentials or prove live execution.

registration_python_api: registry = default_registry()  # or TaskRegistry() for no demo tasks
service.run_experiment(owner, document, idempotency_key, background=True) -> persisted Run
service.start(owner, task_id, executor='deterministic', idempotency_key='', background=True) remains supported
preflight_experiment(document, registry=registry, allow_model_calls=False, copilot_executor=None, native_max_attempts=2, native_timeout_seconds=120) in optimization_framework.service is storage-free
optimization_framework.cli.main(argv=None, registry=registry, copilot_executor=None) lets a trusted host embed CLI with explicit adapters

experiment_cli.run: python3 -m optimization_framework run --experiment DOCUMENT --root PATH [--idempotency-key KEY] [--allow-model-calls]
experiment_cli.legacy: run --task ID --executor deterministic|copilot and existing native flags remain supported
experiment_cli.conflicts: --experiment cannot combine with --task, --executor, --native-max-attempts or --native-timeout-seconds; document policy has one unambiguous source
experiment_cli.custom_domains: Stock CLI registers demos only. Trusted host imports/instantiates adapter, registers it, then calls cli.main(argv, registry=registry). No plugin-discovery or import flag.
